clinical_intent: A brachytherapy plan uses geometric optimization with a reference point at the isocenter of the applicator. The plan has 8 dwell positions with equal initial dwell times of 10 seconds. After optimization, the dwell times range from 2.5 seconds to 18.7 seconds. Calculate the dwell time modulation ratio (maximum/minimum) and evaluate whether this modulation is clinically acceptable. What is the typical range of modulation ratios seen in clinical practice?
